decision_change_criteria: Lower confidence in a proposed mechanism if a source-pinned matched simulation fails under its declared assumptions.
Do not elevate a prescribed support-removal comparator to a historical cause without independent evidence of an initiating mechanism.
Revise the ranking if independently reproduced multiview predictions materially favor one mechanism under shared geometry and event definitions.
decision_to_support: Prioritize public-record retrieval and reproducible experiments that can distinguish competing collapse mechanisms without treating any model output as historical proof.
initial_statement: Given public NIST, UAF, FEMA, and UCL materials, which claims about WTC 7 collapse initiation and propagation are directly supported, model-dependent, or underdetermined, and what matched tests would discriminate them?
minimum_evidence: A reviewed, source-pinned comparison that preserves competing models, assumptions, falsifiers, missing inputs, and result limits.
title: WTC 7 competing collapse-model audit
